title: Met Puts High-Res Files Online
content: The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York has been offering high res digital image files for some time, but now they're making additionalhigh-res filesavailable for free download.This link takes you to the browse page.William Trost Richards • Metropolitan MuseumA museum spokesman says: "Through this new, open-access policy, we join a growing number of museums that provide free access to images of art in the public domain. I am delighted that digital technology can open the doors to this trove of images from our encyclopedic collection."With these files you can get a close up look at the technique and textures. Though the quality of the scans varies from piece to piece (andsome pieces have multiple files), this represents an enlightened step for a major institution, and I hope other museums follow suit to put public domain images online.Via Kottke.org,thanksEric
